description: This PHP source file extends the default list view behavior for the 'Project' module in SuiteCRM. It defines a custom view class 'ProjectViewList' that overrides the preDisplay method to initialize a specific list view implementation using 'ProjectListViewSmarty'. The file includes licensing information, a security check, and a class that customizes project list view behavior.
